exec git init -b main
at 2026-08-14T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix ref-
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential

exec card create --type workstream --key %source 'Parent workstream'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/parent-id.txt
exec card create 'Dependency'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/dependency-id.txt
exec card create --parent %ref-1 --depends-on %ref-2 'Child task'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/child-id.txt

# The Markdown issue-reference marker is accepted on scalar selectors.
exec card --json show %ref-3
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/blocked-child.json

# Selector flags and exact producer keys retain their distinct meanings.
exec card board pin %ref-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/pinned.txt
exec card board pin --key %source
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/already-pinned.txt
exec card --json show --key %source
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/keyed-parent.json
exec card --json list --under %ref-1 --status blocked
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/blocked-descendants.jsonl

# Optional parent values and signed relationship terms strip their markers.
exec card edit %ref-3 --parent %ref-1 --depends-on=-%ref-2
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/edited.txt
exec card --json show %ref-3
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/ready-child.json

# Structured CLI input accepts the same reference spelling for ID targets.
exec card apply update.json
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/applied.txt

# Repeated positional IDs and repeated selector flags share the same parsing.
exec card close %ref-2 %ref-3
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/closed.txt
exec card dump dump --issue %ref-1 --issue %ref-2 --no-descendants
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/dumped.txt
